name: Paleochristian and Byzantine Monuments of Thessalonika
description: Scattered through the modern city of Thessaloniki in northern Greece, fifteen churches, monasteries, walls and a bath trace more than a thousand years of Christian building, from the 4th to the 14th century. Some are simple basilicas, others cross-shaped domed churches. Gleaming gold mosaics in the Rotunda, St Demetrius and the small church of St David rank among early Christian art's finest works.
